card.name: Linking words before reported cases
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'been', 'Several', 'of' and 'the' in warning text, just before the text says events or cases were reported or observed. Often follows 'have' or a section heading.

modes.label: Have been reported
modes.description: The word 'been' after 'have' when a list of adverse reactions is about to be described as reported.
modes.example: acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP) have<< been>> reported with the use of metronid

modes.label: Several studies or instances
modes.description: The word 'Several' opening a sentence after a section heading or a monitoring statement, before studies or cases.
modes.example: 5.4 Myocardial Infarction<< Several>> prospective, observational, epidemiological studies have

modes.label: Of the or the after a quantity
modes.description: Linking words after a percentage or multiple, before a population or limit.
modes.example: Mitochondrial DNA variants are present in less than 1%<< of>> the general US population, and the proportion

card.writes: It favors words like 'reported' and 'novel' and disfavors 'relevant', suggesting it steers toward the wording of case reports.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words just before the text says something was reported in patients or studies.
